query:
WITH ins AS (
            INSERT INTO work_item_comments (work_item_id, user_id, body)
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3)
            RETURNING id, work_item_id, user_id, body, created_at
        )
        SELECT
            ins.id,
            ins.work_item_id,
            ins.user_id,
            u.display_name AS "author_name!",
            ins.body,
            ins.created_at
        FROM ins
        JOIN users u ON u.id = ins.user_id
